settings.title: Residential Lighting
settings.description: A curated selection of pendant lights, sconces, and chandeliers designed to illuminate living spaces with warmth and intention. Each fixture balances form and function.

settings.title: Furniture
settings.description: Handcrafted tables, seating, and storage pieces made from sustainably sourced wood and natural materials. Designed to age gracefully and become part of your home's story.

settings.title: Objects & Accessories
settings.description: Thoughtful objects for daily living. From hand-thrown ceramics to woven textiles, each piece brings texture and character to your interior spaces.

settings.title: Outdoor
settings.description: Weather-resistant lighting and furniture designed for exterior spaces. Bring the same level of detail and craftsmanship to patios, gardens, and terraces.

settings.title: Collections
settings.description: Thoughtfully curated collections of lighting, furniture, and objects for every room. Each piece is selected for its quality, craftsmanship, and timeless design.
